title: oddkin.ai.context-resource
description: A resource a person can add as context. Identity is `sourceId` with `id`.

type.description: What it is, in the host’s words: document, page, account.

kind.description: A stable key for its icon (the picker’s `icons`).

unavailable.description: Why it cannot be used now; absent when it can.

container.description: Opens to show what is inside it when activated; it is not chosen itself.
